queries.result_summary: Event 20161 records source_pack SOURCE_PACK_V1 / lookup V2, git provenance, acceptance_declared=false, and historical_provenance_only notes that router readiness was 5.12 while governed current readiness snapshot was 5.13; existence of older contracts is explicitly not caller-usage evidence.
Temporal order before cutoff is event 20161 on 2026-10-04, receipt 38 on 2026-10-07, SOAK EKB on 2026-10-14 23:39, CP2 authority EKB on 2026-10-14 23:44.

Of 76 historical caller-callee lexical edges, 70 callee tokens are still present in current caller bodies and 6 are absent. All six absent edges belong to callers whose empirical md5(prosrc) differs from historical definition_md5. Among 55 edges on changed-hash callers, 49 retain the historical token and 6 do not.

64 current IG-pattern functions are outside the historical caller identity set; 23 have queue/direct-step/handoff/continuation/context/cached-v2 path-shape names. These are candidate route-evolution signals, not proven callers.

Revision 5.13 has 86 completed runs across 42 screens from 2026-09-28 to 2026-10-05; 5.13.1 has 20 completed runs across 16 screens from 2026-10-08 to 2026-10-14. Both show family_count=47, but zero-stage prevalence and screen mix differ.

Five callers responsible for the six missing historical tokens now reference newer path shapes: bootstrap cached_v1 points to cached_v2; recurate_source_stale points to cached_v2; shadow_evaluate points to bootstrap_classify_v2_ctx; curator_materialize now includes curator plan/handoff and validator handoff; validate_v2 now references evidence rehydrate/semantic-scope paths. This is lexical structural evidence only, not runtime execution proof.

findings.claim: The P0 event itself warns against promoting its snapshot to live authority: acceptance_declared=false and its provenance notes already document version/currentness drift.

Current lexical topology shows selective evolution rather than wholesale disappearance: 70/76 historical callee tokens remain, while six historical edges no longer appear and newer cached/context/handoff paths appear in those changed bodies.
findings.limit: Lexical references do not prove runtime execution.

findings.claim: Queue/direct/handoff/continuation/context/cached-v2 functions are plausible route-evolution candidates outside the historical caller set, but names alone cannot establish that they are callers or were omitted at P0 time.
Performance comparison by revision is temporally and population-confounded even when family_count remains 47; 5.13 and 5.13.1 cover different time windows and screen populations.

causal_hypothesis.claim: The strongest alternative to a simple Curator/Validator defect is evidence staleness plus post-snapshot route evolution and cohort drift. Structural changes are demonstrable; their runtime and causal performance effect is not.
